name: Innate
description: Shared by every member of the character's race or species. A Power of this Source that has no rank of its own counts as your Toughness when a Power that affects other Powers, such as Power Mimicry, is used on it.

name: Magic
description: Magical, divine, infernal or otherwise from beyond the ordinary world. A Power of this Source that has no rank of its own counts as your Willpower when a Power that affects other Powers, such as Power Mimicry, is used on it.

name: Psychic
description: Wells up from a mental or mystical source inside the character. A Power of this Source that has no rank of its own counts as your Willpower when a Power that affects other Powers, such as Power Mimicry, is used on it.

name: Super
description: Caused by a mutation or alteration unique to this character. A Power of this Source that has no rank of its own counts as your Toughness when a Power that affects other Powers, such as Power Mimicry, is used on it.

name: Tech
description: Mechanical or technological. A Power of this Source that has no rank of its own counts as your Toughness when a Power that affects other Powers, such as Power Mimicry, is used on it.

name: Trained
description: Built up by practice, study or training. A Power of this Source that has no rank of its own counts as your Willpower when a Power that affects other Powers, such as Power Mimicry, is used on it.
